Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Unity RPG title-screen background, wide landscape 16:9. Create richly detailed handcrafted pixel art, sophisticated 1990s fantasy RPG cover illustration, sharp intentional pixel clusters, no low-poly 3D. A young adult Brazilian adventurer with medium-brown skin and short dark curly hair, wearing a yellow football-inspired shirt with green collar and blue trousers, on the RIGHT foreground in three-quarter view, resolute expression, fists clenched as he channels a radiant golden aura with upward flame-like energy and small floating stones. He overlooks a lush Brazilian-inspired fantasy village with ochre colonial houses, terracotta roofs, cobblestone lanes, palms, tropical forest, distant mountains, and a mysterious horn-shaped stone monument. Late-afternoon amber light, teal shadows, gold energy accents. LEFT half is a quieter dark forest-and-sky gradient with generous negative space for game title and Play buttons that will be rendered by the engine.
